package logging

import pkglog "github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/pkg/log"

// ZerologErrorLogger adapts the repository logger to the use-case logging port.
type ZerologErrorLogger struct {
	logger pkglog.Logger
}

func NewZerologErrorLogger(logger pkglog.Logger) ZerologErrorLogger {
	return ZerologErrorLogger{logger: logger}
}

func (l ZerologErrorLogger) Error(message string, err error, eventID string) {
	l.logger.Error().Err(err).Str("event_id", eventID).Msg(message)
}
